capabilityIndex.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
capabilityIndex.attribution: Capability scores are published by Artificial Analysis and reproduced with attribution.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.note: OpenAI's frontier model, released 3 September 2026. Maximum output is 128K tokens. Prompts with more than 272K input tokens use the standard long-context column on the pricing page: $20 input / $2 cached / $75 output for the whole request.

models.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.note: OpenAI labels the published $4 input / $0.40 cached / $20 output rate as promotional pricing available at least through November 21, 2026. The pricing page does not state a separate post-promotion standard rate, so that published rate stays the headline. Prompts above 272K input tokens use the pricing table's long-context column, $8 input / $0.80 cached / $30 output, for the whole request. Maximum output is 128K tokens.

models.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
models.note: Published short-context rate is $2 input / $0.20 cached / $12 output. The model page states that prompts with more than 272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and 1.5x output for the full request. The long-context input ($4) and output ($18) are derived from that multiplier applied to the published $2 / $12 rates. The model page does not state a long-context cached rate, so this band keeps the published cached rate of $0.20. Maximum output is 128K tokens.

models.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
models.note: Published short-context rate is $0.20 input / $0.02 cached / $1.20 output. The model page states that prompts with more than 272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and 1.5x output for the full request. The long-context input ($0.40) and output ($1.80) are derived from that multiplier applied to the published $0.20 / $1.20 rates. The model page does not state a long-context cached rate, so this band keeps the published cached rate of $0.02. Maximum output is 128K tokens.

models.name: Claude Opus 5
models.note: Frontier reasoning and agentic model; succeeds Opus 4.8.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.note: Cache hits and refreshes are priced at 0.025x base input ($0.25 / 1M) instead of the usual 0.1x. Supersedes Claude Fable 5.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5
models.note: Permanent standard rate ($2 input / $10 output / $0.20 cached).

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.note: Prices unchanged at $1 input / $0.10 cache read / $5 output. The Sonnet 5.5 model comparison lists a 200K context window and 64K maximum output (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/overview). Still Active; retirement is not sooner than October 15, 2026 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations).

models.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
models.note: Standard price shown for prompts up to 200K tokens (inclusive). Prompts above 200K bill $4 input, $0.40 cached input, and $18 output per million tokens.

models.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.note: Standard rate shown. An introductory rate of $0.75 input / $0.075 cached / $3.75 output runs through December 31, 2026. 1M input limit with 64K max output.

models.name: Grok 4.6
models.note: Prompts at or above 200K use $4 input, $1 cached input, and $12 output per million tokens.

models.name: Grok 4.5
models.note: Prompts at or above 200K use $4 input, $0.60 cached input, and $12 output per million tokens.

models.name: Grok Build 0.1
models.note: Agentic coding and tool-calling model. Prompts at or above 200K tokens use $2 input, $0.40 cached input, and $4 output per million tokens for the whole request. Context window is 256K.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
models.note: Input and output are the published peak rates ($1.32 in / $3.96 out). Peak hours are 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday; all other hours bill at half those rates ($0.66 in / $1.98 out). The cached rate is not a published figure: it is a time-weighted blend of the $0.044 peak and $0.022 off-peak cache-hit rates, weighted by the 35 peak and 133 off-peak hours in a week.

models.name: Codestral
models.note: Specialized model for code generation and Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) workflows. Mistral publishes no cached input rate for it, so cache reads are priced at the full input rate. The catalog previously carried $0.03, which appears on no Mistral page.

models.name: GLM-5.3
models.note: Flagship 1M context model; available through GLM Coding Plan and OpenCode Zen.

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash
models.note: Standard rate shown; the 50% promotional rate that ran through September 9, 2026 has ended. Cached input storage is free for a limited time.

models.name: Kimi K3
models.note: Also available through OpenCode Zen; web search is billed separately.

models.name: Kimi K2.7 Code
models.note: Coding-specialized API; not ranked for general writing or research.

models.name: Muse Spark 1.3
models.note: Standard tier, not used to improve Meta products. A contributor tier (muse-spark-1.3-contributor) costs $0.10 input / $0.002 cached / $0.20 output in exchange for allowing Meta to train on prompts and outputs.

models.name: Qwen3.8-Max
models.note: International (Singapore) endpoint rate. The Beijing, US, Germany, Japan, and Hong Kong endpoints bill lower at $1.65 input / $0.206 cached / $4.951 output. Max input is 991,808 tokens of the 1M window.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.note: Replaces DeepSeek V4 Flash; called as `deepseek-flash`, and the legacy `deepseek-v4-flash` identifier still routes here at Flash pricing. Input and output are the published peak rates ($0.30 in / $1.20 out). Peak hours are 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday; all other hours bill at half those rates ($0.15 in / $0.60 out). The cached rate is not a published figure: it is a time-weighted blend of the $0.006 peak and $0.003 off-peak cache-hit rates, weighted by the 35 peak and 133 off-peak hours in a week. Maximum output is 384K tokens.

models.name: Grok 4.7
models.note: Released 21 September 2026 at Grok 4.6 prices. Prompts at or above 200K use $4 input, $1 cached input, and $12 output per million tokens. A fast variant, available through Cursor and Grok Build only, serves output at twice the speed for twice the price.

models.name: Step 5 Preview
models.note: StepFun's flagship agentic model, released 18 September 2026. Sparse mixture-of-experts with text, image and video input. Maximum output is 64K tokens, and output tokens include the reasoning trace. The cache-miss input price covers writing new content to the cache.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.note: Succeeds Opus 5 at a lower price. Cache reads are 0.05x input rather than Anthropic's usual 0.1x. The full 1M window is billed at standard rates; fast mode ($8 / $40) is a separate premium tier, not the headline rate.

models.name: GPT-6 Sol
models.note: GPT-6 mid tier, built for complex coding and agentic work. Half the published GPT-5.6 Sol price. Maximum output is 128K tokens. The model page states that prompts with more than 272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output for the whole request. The long-context band ($4 input / $0.40 cached / $15 output) is derived from that multiplier applied to the published $2 / $0.20 / $10 rates. The pricing table does not list a separate long-context row for this model.

models.name: GPT-6 Luna
models.note: OpenAI's most efficient GPT-6 model, for focused, high-volume tasks. Maximum output is 128K tokens. Prompts with more than 272K input tokens use the standard long-context column: $0.20 input / $0.02 cached / $0.75 output for the whole request.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
models.note: Newer Sol model, described by OpenAI as near-Astra performance for complex work at a lower cost. Same input and output rates as GPT-6 Sol with half the cached rate. GPT-6 Sol remains available. Maximum output is 128K tokens. Prompts with more than 272K input tokens use the standard long-context column: $4 input / $0.20 cached / $15 output for the whole request.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.note: Released September 28, 2026. Cache reads were cut from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens on October 7, 2026 (0.05x base input). 5-minute cache writes stay $2.50 and 1-hour cache writes stay $4. The Batch API is 50% off input and output. US-only inference is 1.1x. Retirement is not sooner than September 28, 2027. Maximum output is 128K tokens on the synchronous API.

models.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
models.note: Released October 7, 2026. Prompts up to 100,000 tokens are $0.10 input / $0.01 cache read / $0.50 output; prompts over 100,000 tokens are $0.50 / $0.05 / $2.50 for the whole request. 5-minute cache writes are $0.125 below that line and $0.625 above it; 1-hour cache writes are $0.20 and $1. The Batch API is 50% off input and output. Synchronous maximum output is 128K tokens; the Message Batches API allows 300K with the output-300k-2026-03-24 beta header. Retirement is not sooner than October 7, 2027.

models.name: Mistral Large 4
models.note: Public Preview since October 6, 2026. Open-weight Mixture-of-Experts; the changelog says open weights are coming soon. Standard rate is $1.36 input / $0.14 cached / $4.18 output. A 2-week 50% launch sale ($0.68 input / $0.07 cached / $2.09 output) is on the model card and is not the headline. The changelog says the sale lasts two weeks from the October 6 release and does not print a calendar end date, so October 20, 2026 is derived as fourteen days after October 6.
